lines.text: The chief priests and elders came to Jesus in the temple courts and asked who gave Him His authority.
Jesus asked whether John's baptism was from heaven or from men, and promised to answer them if they answered Him.
The leaders feared the Romans, so they told Jesus they did not know, and He refused to tell them.
A man told his first son to work in the vineyard, and the son refused but later went.
The leaders said the second son did his father's will, and Jesus said tax collectors enter God's kingdom before them.
